title: Empirica observer: one run's detail (GET /api/run?key=KEY, observe --run KEY)
description: What the detail panel shows for one run, beyond its row in the store summary (the row owns state, diagnostic and audit state; nothing here repeats them). Same ownership as view.schema.json; reason messages come from the public-contract registry. Enumerations are held equal to their owners by scripts/validate_ui_view.py.

version.description: Equal to the run's version in the view it belongs to.

control.description: How the run's configuration was governed (state.schema governance.control_mode / state).

findings.description: The latest verdict's findings while they are the current failure (the plugin's run view).

residuals.description: Why the run stopped short (the plugin's residuals), each with the registry's message.

prompt_error.description: Why the run's pending confirmation batch cannot be shown to a human now (the run view's confirmation_batch.prompt_error): nobody to ask, already shown (asked again only if something changes), or the run's human interactions are spent. Null when a host will ask, and when nothing waits.

waiting.description: What the host will ask a human at the end of the pass (ADR-0067): the run view's confirmation_batch, per claim: how many research records need the human's confirmation and whether the claim itself needs the human's decision. Empty unless the run is active and something waits. Not a list of everything unconfirmed: the claims' own records and decisions say that.

route.description: human: the host will ask; unavailable: the host has nobody to ask, so the requirement stays open; shown: already shown, asked again only if something changes; limit: the run's human interactions are spent.

stale.description: Files whose current workspace observation differs from what an active spike executed against (the plugin's freshness changes).

author.description: The host-observed author identity; null when none was observed.

auditor.description: The host-observed identity of the latest verdict's auditor; null when none.

steps.description: Every recorded history artifact in causal order.

outcome.description: research: supporting/refuting; spike: its gate; audit_verdict: its verdict; null otherwise.

records.description: Every research record on the claim as worded now, in the order recorded, with how each is verified (ADR-0067).

outcome.description: The human's answer; null while it waits.

answer.description: The human's optional answer, in their words.

route.description: Who can answer, while it waits (as for waiting.route; ended: the run is no longer active, so nobody will ask); null once answered.

decision.description: A needs-decision claim's human decision; null for every other claim kind.

blocker_message.description: The public-contract registry's message for the claim's blocker in the view; null exactly when that blocker is null.

spikes_ever.description: Spikes ever executed for this claim, superseded included.

class.description: How the record can be verified (core/citations.py).

route.description: Where a pending confirmation goes (as for decision.route; audit: the independent audit fetches it); null unless the record is pending.

retrieve.description: The auditor must retrieve the source (its kind is within the host's observed retrieval).

spike_unavailable.description: Why no deterministic spike could establish an observed record; null for other classes.

note.description: The human's note to the author, when the receipt has one.
